newsitem.title: USA: MEMC says orders increasing after Q1 loss.
newsitem.headline: MEMC says orders increasing after Q1 loss.

text.p: MEMC Electronic Materials Inc said Wednesday it was experiencing increased order activity after posting a loss in the first quarter.

"We feel confident that MEMC reached the lowest level of demand in the fourth quarter of 1996," chief executive officer Ludger Viefhues said in a statement. "We would expect that net sales in the subsequent quarters of 1997 will show sequential improvement, reflecting the gradual recovery under way in the semiconductor industry."

In the first quarter of 1997 the gross margin was 12.6 percent, compared to 27.4 percent in the year-ago period, but up from 6.7 percent in the previous quarter, reflecting improving capacity utilization, particularly for large-diameter epitaxial wafers, the silicon wafer manufacturer said.
Earlier Wednesday, the company reported a net loss of $2.8 million, or $0.07 a share, in the first quarter, compared to profit of $39.6 million, or $0.96 a share, a year ago.
